name: USANA Health Sciences, Inc.
business_overview: USANA Health Sciences, Inc. develops, manufactures, and sells science-based nutritional, personal care, and skincare products in the Asia Pacific, the Americas, and Europe. It operates in two segments, Core nutritional and Hiya Direct-To-Consumer. The company offers USANA nutritional optimizers, including supplements for cardiovascular health, skeletal/structural health, and digestive health; Essentials/CellSentials, such as vitamin and mineral supplements for age group beginning with children 13 months of age; and food products that include meal replacement shakes, snack bars, and other related products for healthy weight management, digestive health, and energy and hydration. It offers Celavive, a skincare regimen for various skin care types and ethnicities; and all other products comprising materials and online tools for associates to build business and marketing of products The company sells its products through retail customers, a subscription model, and direct selling, as well as online. The company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah.

classification_meta.logic_summary: USANA develops, manufactures, and sells science-based nutritional and personal care products through a combination of direct selling and subscription models, targeting retail customers globally.

narrative.text:
**Business & market dynamics:** Core top-line performance is stable, with revenue meeting expectations while earnings surprised sharply to the upside. China stands out as a key growth catalyst, with active customer numbers rising around the Lunar New Year and fueling sequential sales improvement. The younger HYA subscription brand is also building a growing base of monthly subscribers, validating the move beyond traditional direct selling. The outlook, however, is shaded by persistent margin pressures, suggesting that competitive dynamics and the cost of building an omnichannel presence are weighing on profitability even as demand holds up.

**Management strategy and execution:** Leadership is driving a deliberate shift toward an omnichannel model and brand diversification, complementing the legacy distributor network with direct-to-consumer and subscription offerings. The team demonstrated strong operational discipline by delivering a large earnings beat in the most recent quarter despite the investment cycle. Forward guidance was set slightly above market expectations, projecting confidence. Early indicators from subsequent quarters—such as sequential revenue growth and subscriber gains—suggest the strategy is gaining traction, lending credibility to management’s ability to execute the transformation while navigating margin headwinds.

# USNA Q4 Deep Dive: Omnichannel Push and Brand Expansion Shape Outlook Amid Margin Pressures

Health and wellness products company USANA Health Sciences (NYSE: USNA) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q4 CY2025, with sales up 5.9% year on year to $226.2 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $962.5 million at the midpoint came in 0.7% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.60 per share was 46.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
